review_scope: Indexed primary results and yeast-expression/enzyme-assay methods; supplements and underlying chromatograms not independently reanalyzed
product_evidence: Retention time and tandem-mass-spectral comparison with authentic standard support apigenin identification.
substrate_stereochemistry: Not resolved by the reviewed methods wording; do not silently assert an enantiopure assay substrate.

electron_transfer.boundary: Microsomal turnover does not identify an endogenous Cannabis electron-transfer partner or establish free-flavin catalysis.

claim_boundary: Reference biochemical evidence only. The cDNA cross-reference joins the study to UniProt, not to a fully reconstructed experimental construct. Assay additives are not automatically network reactants or organic carbon seeds. Cannabis specificity, carrier regeneration and physiological flux remain unestablished.
